title: 2PC 协调者崩溃：参与者阻塞与状态不一致
expected_output:
phase1 all prepared (vote YES): True
coordinator crashed before sending COMMIT to P3
P1 committed=True P2 committed=True P3 committed=False
blocked participants: ['P3']
inconsistent state: True
recovery: replayed decision log -> all committed: True
code:
# 2PC 两阶段提交：协调者在发完部分 COMMIT 后崩溃 -> 参与者阻塞、状态不一致
class Participant:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
        self.locked = False        # 持有事务资源/锁
        self.committed = False
        self.decision_known = False

    def prepare(self):
        self.locked = True         # 进入 prepared 状态，持锁等待决定
        return True                # 表决 YES

    def commit(self):
        self.committed = True
        self.locked = False
        self.decision_known = True

    def block(self):
        return (not self.committed) and self.locked


def run_crash_scenario():
    ps = [Participant("P1"), Participant("P2"), Participant("P3")]
    votes = [p.prepare() for p in ps]
    print("phase1 all prepared (vote YES):", all(votes))
    # 协调者决定 COMMIT，先发给 P1/P2，发 P3 之前崩溃
    for p in ps[:2]:
        p.commit()
    print("coordinator crashed before sending COMMIT to P3")
    blocked = [p.name for p in ps if p.block()]
    states = " ".join("%s committed=%s" % (p.name, p.committed) for p in ps)
    print(states)
    print("blocked participants:", blocked)
    inconsistent = len({p.committed for p in ps}) > 1
    print("inconsistent state:", inconsistent)
    return ps


def run_recovery(ps):
    # 恢复：协调者读取决定日志，重发 COMMIT
    for p in ps:
        if not p.committed:
            p.commit()
    print("recovery: replayed decision log -> all committed:",
          all(p.committed for p in ps))


ps = run_crash_scenario()
run_recovery(ps)
